name: Pomerium-Proxy
description: Pomerium Nginx Proxy - Secure, identity-aware access from anywhere.

paths.name: NginxProxyManager Letsencrypt SSL folder
paths.description: Nginx Proxy Manager Letsencrypt SSL certificate folder that can be found in /appdata/NginxProxyManager/letsencrypt

variables.name: Pomerium Domain
variables.description: If you have a wildcard domain name on DuckDNS or elsewhere, please put it here eg 'example.duckdns.org'

variables.name: Pomerium upstream container
variables.description: The Pomerium container Host:[Port] to use as Pomerium upstream

variables.name: Pomerium verify upstream container
variables.description: The Pomerium container Host:[Port] to use as Verify upstream

variables.name: Forward Auth URL
variables.description: Forward server name. The name will be concateneted with POMERIUM_DOMAIN. Remember to create the appropriate rules on your reverse proxy web server

variables.name: Authenticate Service URL
variables.description: Pomerium Authenticate server name. The name will be concateneted with POMERIUM_DOMAIN. Remember to create the appropriate rules on your reverse proxy web server

variables.name: Verify Service URL
variables.description: Pomerium Verify server name. The name will be concatenated with POMERIUM_DOMAIN. Remember to create the appropriate rules on your reverse proxy web server

variables.name: SSL Certificate
variables.description: The SSL certificate from the NginxProxyManager volume

variables.name: SSL Certificate Key
variables.description: The SSL certificate key from the NginxProxyManager volume
